routine: Full Body Strength: Warm-up (5-10 min light cardio & dynamic stretches). Exercises: Goblet Squats (3 sets x 10-12 reps), Dumbbell Rows (3 sets x 10-12 reps per arm), Push-ups (3 sets to failure or 10-15 reps), Dumbbell Shoulder Press (3 sets x 10-12 reps), Plank (3 sets x 45-60 sec hold). Cool-down (5-10 min static stretches).

Cardio Endurance: 40-50 minutes of moderate-intensity cardio. Choose from brisk walking, jogging, cycling, or elliptical. Maintain a pace where you can talk but feel slightly breathless. Include a 5-minute warm-up and 5-minute cool-down.

Lower Body & Core Focus: Warm-up (5-10 min light cardio & dynamic stretches). Exercises: Lunges (3 sets x 10-12 reps per leg), Romanian Deadlifts (light dumbbells, 3 sets x 10-12 reps), Glute Bridges (3 sets x 12-15 reps), Leg Raises (3 sets x 15-20 reps), Side Plank (3 sets x 30-45 sec per side). Cool-down (5-10 min static stretches).

Active Recovery & Flexibility: 30-45 minutes of light activity focusing on mobility and recovery. Options: Yoga, Pilates, foam rolling session, light stretching, or a very gentle walk in nature. Focus on deep breathing and lengthening muscles.

Upper Body & Core Strength: Warm-up (5-10 min light cardio & dynamic stretches). Exercises: Dumbbell Bench Press (3 sets x 10-12 reps), Lat Pulldowns or Assisted Pull-ups (3 sets x 10-12 reps), Overhead Triceps Extension (3 sets x 12-15 reps), Bicep Curls (3 sets x 12-15 reps), Bird-Dog (3 sets x 10-12 reps per side). Cool-down (5-10 min static stretches).

Outdoor Activity / Long Cardio: 45-60 minutes of varied cardio or an enjoyable outdoor activity. Options: Hiking, swimming, long bike ride, a sports game with friends, or a longer sustained run/jog. Focus on sustained effort and enjoyment.
Rest Day: Complete rest from structured exercise. Focus on hydration, nutrition, and allowing your body to recover and rebuild. Light stretching is optional if muscles feel tight.
